text: How LuchoAI works. Your football coach for ages 8 to 18.
Open LuchoAI and tap Get started.
Step 1: Switch on your AI coach.
A grown-up picks an AI company.
Then pastes in the AI key. It stays on this device.
Step 2: Make your player profile.
Answer five quick questions about you.
Done! Now pick what to do first.
Step 3: Train with your coach.
Ask your coach anything about football.
Your coach answers, just for you.
Make a training plan for your week.
Save it, and see how to set up each drill.
Step 4: Play, think and check in.
New games to play every Monday.
Game IQ: drag yourself to the best spot.
Then watch what happens!
Check in with how you feel.
It stays on this device, just for you.
You're ready to play! Tap Get started to switch on your coach and make your profile. Games and Wellbeing work without an AI key.
